title: File:Traffic lights in Turin 2021.jpg
description: Traffic light system in "via D'Azeglio" in Turin (Italy). Both the green and the amber lights are on at the same time. This is against the Italian Highway Code at the time this picture was taken (December 2021). A right turn separate green light and a pedestrian traffic light, seen from the side, are also visible. The pedestrian light is also not up to code, since it hasn't an amber light.
categories: Proceed straight or turn right mandatory road signs in Italy
